source: OpenAlex API /works (IDs written from the response by scripts/run_search.py)
query: "digital government" AND (municipal OR "local government" OR city)
filter: title_and_abstract.search.exact:"digital government" AND (municipal OR "local government" OR city),is_retracted:false,publication_year:2022-2026
oql:
get works where retracted is (false)
  and year >= (2022)
  and year <= (2026)
  and title-abstract has ("digital government" AND ("local government" OR "city" OR "municipal"))
